subject: Request: Classroom credits and self-serve promo for CS580
messages:
From: Dr. Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@elmwood.edu>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Classroom credits for CS580

Hi Soojin,

I'm teaching CS580 (Applied NLP) next term and we'd like to use Redwood for an in-class cohort assignment — small model experiments, embeddings for dataset search, and a handful of generation tasks. I signed up through the PLG flow but ran into the trial quota limit when I tried to onboard the course GitHub repo.

Can Elmwood qualify for an academic promo or top-up? We are a .edu, attached is the course syllabus and our tax-exempt certificate. Expecting ~25 students, peak ~12 concurrent requests during grading windows, roughly 120k tokens/week for the semester. If you need more info I can provide enrollment lists or a letter from the department.

Also — is there a simple self-serve promo code flow instructors can redeem, or does the credits issuance need an account-level change from your side? Ideally I'd like a redeemable code we can hand to students.

Thanks,
Aaron
Dr. Aaron Feldman
Associate Professor, Computer Science
Elmwood University
aaron.feldman@elmwood.edu

Attachments: course-syllabus.pdf, elmwood-tax-exempt.pdf

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Dr. Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@elmwood.edu>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Classroom credits for CS580

Hi Aaron — welcome and thanks for the details.

Quick checklist so we can move to issuance:
- Confirm the instructor email domain is .edu (looks like it is) and whether students will use institutional emails or personal addresses.
- Confirm whether you want a single redeemable promo code for the class (students redeem individually) or a credits top-up on one shared account.
- Approximate start/end dates for the semester (so we can set expiry).

We have a self-serve promo flow for classroom use: we can create a redeemable code (value in tokens) that students can enter on the Redwood signup page. Ops will also generate an audit entry and optional quota per-code. If you want, Marissa (student programs) can provision a provisional credit allocation while we validate the paperwork.

I've looped in Marissa to confirm typical amounts and Dev to handle the promo generation and audit logs. If you prefer a single shared account, let us know the admin email and we can top it up instead.

Link to short verification form: https://redwood.app/portal/credit-requests/ELM-5734

Best,
Soojin Lee
Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

(Attachment: none)

From: Dr. Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@elmwood.edu>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Classroom credits for CS580

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick reply.

Answers:
- Students will use their Elmwood .edu emails for course work (we control accounts).
- We'd prefer a single redeemable promo code per semester that each student redeems during signup (keeps tracking simple).
- Semester dates: Jan 10 2027 - May 5 2027, but we want the code to be redeemable from Dec 15 2026 for early setup and expire May 31 2027.
- If you need a departmental contact for the admin shared account, that's Dr. Karen Mills (k.mills@elmwood.edu).

I attached a short enrollment estimate and the tax-exempt cert to this reply. Let me know the next steps and expected timeline. We have a vendor onboarding window in mid-December.

Thanks,
Aaron

Attachments: course-syllabus.pdf (again), elmwood-tax-exempt.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Classroom credits for CS580

Looping in final approval from Student Programs. Per our academic playbook, Elmwood qualifies for a classroom allocation with the .edu domain and tax-exempt docs. Proposed allocation: 100,000 tokens for the semester, redeemable by students via a single promo code.

Notes for Ops (Dev):
- HubSpot deal HS-8421 created; set HubSpot property "academic_allocation" = 100000.
- Promo must be redeemable only for accounts created with a @*.edu email. Block redemptions for consumer domains.
- Redemption window: 2026-12-15 -> 2027-05-31.
- Expiry: tokens expire 2027-06-15 for bookkeeping.

Please generate a redeemable code and confirm the exact code value and redemption URL so I can email the department.

—Marissa
Academic Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Dr. Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@elmwood.edu>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Classroom credits for CS580

Thanks — issuing now.

Promo details (provisioned):

- Value: 100000 tokens total; per-account cap 8000 tokens (prevents single-user exhaustion)
- Redeem URL: https://redwood.app/signup?promo=ELMWOOD-SEM23-100K
- Redemption window: 2026-12-15T00:00:00Z -> 2027-05-31T23:59:59Z
- Token expiry (account ledger view): 2027-06-15T23:59:59Z
- Constraints: allowed_email_domain = elmwood.edu; rate-limit: 10 redemptions/minute; audit_id: AUD-20261102-379

Attachments: promo-code-stub.txt (contains masked code + issuance log). I also updated HubSpot (HS-8421) and added the audit record.

Aaron — you can distribute the redeem URL and code to students after Dec 15. If you'd like the code to be case-insensitive or have a friendlier string, we can re-issue once.

Marissa/Soojin — please confirm and I'll close the ticket and push the audit to long-term retention.
